name: Supine Elbow Press
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, then plant your elbows beside your ribs with forearms pointing up.
Brace your core lightly so your lower back stays calm and neutral against the floor.
Drive both elbows into the floor to lift your upper back while drawing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly at the top of the lift, then lower your upper back slowly back onto the floor.
tips: Do not lift your hips into a bridge or push backward with your head; generate the lift purely by driving your elbows downward.
Keep your shoulders pulled down away from your ears as you pinch your shoulder blades together.
